name: Tube Investments of India Limited
summary: Tube Investments of India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of engineering, mobility, and metal formed products in India and internationally. It operates through nine segments: Engineering, Metal Formed Products, Mobility, Gear and Gear Products, Power Systems, Industrial Systems, Semiconductors, Electric Vehicles, and Medical. The Engineering segment offers cold rolled steel strips, precision steel tubes, cold drawn welded tubes, electric resistance welded tubes, and tubular components.
